newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: GOLF-MONTGOMERIE WINS BY FOUR WITH A 63.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-MONTGOMERIE WINS BY FOUR WITH A 63.

text.p: Colin Montgomerie fired an eight-under-par 63 to win the European Masters by four shots from fellow Scot Sam Torrance on Sunday with a record aggregate of 260, 24 under par.
Montgomerie, who carded 61 in Saturday's third round, broke the record of 261 for the event set by Canadian Jerry Anderson in 1984 as he regained the lead of the Order of Merit.
Torrance, who had begun the day leading by one shot, shot 68 for 264 with Englishman Paul Curry third on 267 after a 66.

It was Montgomerie's third European Tour victory of the year and the 12th of his career. He earned 127,950 pounds ($200,300) and moved above Ian Woosnam in his bid to become the European number one for a record-tying fourth successive year.
